title: SXSW 2027 travel guide: Hotels, flights, and useful tips
summary: Plan your SXSW 2027 trip to Austin with tips for hotels, flights, budgeting, transportation, reservations, packing, dining, and departure.
body_markdown:
## Key takeaways


SXSW 2027 takes place March 15-21, 2027, throughout downtown Austin. With the Austin Convention Center closed for redevelopment, the event will operate as a pop-up Creative Village across hotels, theaters, clubhouses, and other venues. This guide covers where to stay, budgeting for the trip, planning your agenda, navigating the distributed venues, and preparing for departure.


- Downtown hotels fill up quickly during SXSW, so compare options based on where most of your sessions, meetings, and events will take place.
- SXSW hotel rates can run well above federal lodging per diem caps, so budget for the difference before you book.
- Book flights, hotels, and restaurant reservations in one chat with[Navan Edge](https://navan.com/product/navan-edge) , the personal assistant for business travel powered by AI and 24/7 human travel experts.
- Build your agenda around your highest-priority sessions, screenings, showcases, and meetings, leaving enough time to walk between venues.
- Mark the March 9 reservation window on your calendar and reserve space at high-priority events as soon as booking opens.
- Send follow-ups within 48 hours while conversations and next steps are still fresh.


SXSW 2027 brings Innovation, Film & TV, Music, Comedy, and the new Podcast Festival together across downtown Austin while the Austin Convention Center remains under construction.\[1\]\[2\] Because programming is distributed throughout the city center, your badge, hotel location, and daily agenda will shape how easily you can move between sessions and events. Planning around your priorities and choosing a conveniently located hotel can help you spend less time in transit and more time making useful connections.


## What is SXSW and who is it for?


SXSW is an annual conference and festival that brings together professionals and creators working across technology, business, film and television, music, comedy, media, and culture. The flagship event takes place March 15-21, 2027, across downtown Austin, where hotels, theaters, clubhouses, and other venues will form a pop-up Creative Village while the Austin Convention Center remains under construction.\[1\]\[2\]


SXSW attracts a broad mix of attendees:


- **The Innovation Conference** is designed for founders, executives, investors, marketers, product professionals, designers, technologists, and other business leaders.
- **The Film & TV Festival** draws filmmakers, performers, producers, studios, and entertainment professionals.
- **The Music Festival** brings together artists and members of the music industry.


The event also includes Comedy programming and — new for 2027 — a dedicated Podcast Festival for creators, hosts, producers, advertisers, and media professionals.


SXSW EDU takes place separately from March 13-16, 2027, and focuses on educators, administrators, policymakers, students, and other professionals working in education.\[1\]\[5\] This guide focuses on the flagship SXSW event in Austin, not SXSW EDU, SXSW London, or other editions.


## What makes SXSW 2027 worth the trip


SXSW gives attendees opportunities to explore developments across technology, business, film, television, music, comedy, and podcasting while meeting professionals from industries that don't typically gather at a single event.


Whether you're evaluating new technology, meeting potential partners, tracking cultural and industry trends, seeking investment opportunities, or building professional relationships, SXSW brings together experiences and conversations that can be difficult to replicate remotely.


Plan your time around these in-person experiences:


- **Innovation Conference:** Attend sessions, workshops, mentor events, and meetups covering technology and AI, brand and marketing, startups, the creator economy, workplace trends, design, health, sports, and other topics. Core Innovation programming takes place Monday-Friday, March 15-19.\[2\]\[3\]
- **SXSW Pitch and Expo:** Discover emerging companies and technologies, watch startup pitches, speak with founders, and connect with potential investors, partners, and customers.
- **Industry clubhouses:** Visit the Innovation Clubhouse at Brazos Hall, Film & TV Clubhouse at 800 Congress, and Music Clubhouse at Thompson Austin for industry-specific programming, meetings, and informal conversations.\[2\]
- **Film & TV Festival:** Attend premieres and screenings at ACL Live at the Moody Theater and other venues across Austin. With the Paramount Theatre under construction, complimentary shuttles will connect badgeholders with most official screening locations.\[2\]
- **Music and Comedy festivals:** See established and emerging performers at official showcases and connect with artists and entertainment-industry professionals.
- **Podcast Festival:** Attend live recordings and programming about podcast creation, talent, advertising, and the business of audio from March 17-20.\[2\]
- **Brand activations and events:** Explore product demonstrations, pop-ups, exhibits, and events organized by companies throughout downtown Austin.


You don't need to experience every corner of SXSW to make the trip worthwhile. Focus on the sessions, meetings, and events most relevant to your work, while leaving room for the unexpected conversations and cross-industry connections that distinguish SXSW from a traditional conference.


## Where to stay for SXSW 2027


Choosing the right hotel for SXSW 2027 depends on which parts of the event you plan to attend most often. Because the Austin Convention Center remains closed, programming will take place across hotels, theaters, clubhouses, and other downtown venues. Staying near your primary conference or clubhouse can make it easier to move between sessions, meetings, and evening events without relying heavily on rideshares.

Although the convention center itself is closed, many nearby hotels remain within the downtown SXSW footprint.\[8\]


### Hotel pricing during SXSW


Navan analyzed anonymized hotel bookings near downtown Austin during SXSW 2026 to provide context for 2027 pricing.\[10\] Use these benchmarks while planning your trip:


- **Median hotel rate:** The median nightly rate during SXSW week was $493, roughly 51% higher than the $326 median during a quieter week later that March.\[10\]
- **Stay length:** Business travelers booked an average stay of 2.6 nights.\[10\]
- **Late bookings:** Around 52% of SXSW-week stays were booked within two weeks of arrival.\[10\]
- **Booking window:** The median nightly rate was $647 for reservations made at least two months ahead, $593 one to two months ahead, $537 two to four weeks ahead, $461 one to two weeks ahead, and $442 during the final seven days.\[10\]


Official SXSW hotels are available through SXSW Housing. Badgeholders receive a custom booking link after purchasing their credentials and can access discounted rates at participating properties.\[7\] If you're booking through the official housing program, keep these points in mind:


- **Choose based on programming:** Several official hotels also serve as SXSW venues, so consider where your primary sessions and events will take place.
- **Compare the total cost:** Review taxes, deposits, parking charges, and cancellation terms in addition to the nightly rate.
- **Check change policies:** Confirm whether reservation changes must be made through SXSW Housing or directly with the hotel.
- **Book while suitable options remain:** Downtown options become more limited as SXSW approaches, particularly at hotels near major programming venues.


### SXSW flight trends


Austin-Bergstrom International Airport (AUS), approximately 8 miles southeast of downtown Austin, is the primary airport for SXSW attendees.\[8\]\[12\] Navan flight data from SXSW week 2026 includes 1,197 business travel bookings to Austin, with 7.8% originating outside the U.S.\[10\] The most common origin locations were Los Angeles, Newark, San Francisco, and New York.


Arriving Sunday, March 14, gives Innovation attendees time to check into their hotel and prepare before programming begins Monday. Travelers arriving from another time zone may benefit from arriving earlier. Before heading to your first event, connect your badge to your SXSW ID and confirm the latest credential pickup instructions.\[4\]

## How to budget for SXSW


Plan your SXSW 2027 budget around the full cost of the trip, including registration, airfare, lodging, local transportation, meals, and other travel expenses. Accounting for these costs upfront can help you set a realistic budget before requesting approval.


### Federal per diem for Austin


The U.S. General Services Administration sets federal per diem rates for lodging, meals, and incidental expenses. These rates apply to federal employees traveling on official business, although some companies also use them as benchmarks when setting travel budgets and reimbursement limits.


For SXSW 2027, the FY2027 rates for Austin (Travis County) are:


- **$264 per day combined:** Includes $184 for nightly lodging, excluding taxes, plus $80 for daily meals and incidental expenses (M&IE)\[9\]
- **M&IE breakdown:** Includes $20 for breakfast, $22 for lunch, $33 for dinner, and $5 for incidentals\[9\]
- **First and last travel days:** Includes an M&IE allowance of $60, or 75% of the daily rate\[9\]


The $184 federal lodging allowance is considerably lower than the $493 median nightly rate in Navan's SXSW-week 2026 hotel data.\[9\]\[10\] If your company uses GSA rates as a benchmark, budget for that difference or compare hotels farther from your primary venues while accounting for the additional transportation costs.


### Other expenses to consider


Planning for these expenses before you book can make it easier to stay within budget and avoid surprises when it's time to submit your expense report.


- **Conference registration:** SXSW badges start at $550 for Music, $775 for Film & TV, $895 for Innovation, and $1,395 for Platinum. The application-only CxO Badge starts at $6,095. Rates increase as the event approaches, so confirm current pricing before purchasing.\[4\]
- **Airfare:** Flight prices vary by origin and booking date. Compare schedules as well as fares, particularly if arriving Sunday to attend Innovation programming Monday morning.
- **Airport transportation:** CapMetro Route 20 connects AUS with downtown Austin for $1.25 each way. Travelers can also use a taxi or rideshare, but fares may increase during periods of high demand.\[11\]\[12\]
- **Meals:** Budget for meals that aren't included with a conference session, meeting, or event. If catering is provided, check whether your company requires you to reduce your daily meal allowance.
- **Client and team dinners:** Popular downtown restaurants and private dining spaces can fill up quickly during SXSW. Account for taxes, tips, and transportation in addition to the cost of the meal.
- **Local transportation:** Many downtown venues are walkable, but you may still need rideshares, taxis, public transit, or SXSW shuttles when events are farther apart or run late.
- **After-hours events:** Leave room in your budget for showcases, partner receptions, brand activations, and other events that may require transportation, food, drinks, or separate admission.


## Plan your SXSW agenda


SXSW takes place across numerous downtown venues, making it impossible to attend every session, screening, showcase, meeting, and event. Start by identifying the programming most relevant to your goals, then leave time for clubhouses, brand activations, unscheduled conversations, and walking between venues.


Here's a high-level look at the week:\[1\]\[2\]\[6\]


- **Monday (March 15):** SXSW Conferences & Festivals begin, along with the first day of Innovation programming
- **Tuesday (March 16):** Innovation, Film & TV, and Music programming continues across downtown Austin
- **Wednesday (March 17):** Comedy and Podcast festivals begin
- **Thursday-Friday (March 18-19):** Innovation, Film & TV, Music, Comedy, and Podcast programming and events continue
- **Saturday (March 20):** Film & TV, Music, Comedy, and Podcast programming continues; Innovation badgeholders can attend Saturday Film and Music keynotes and featured sessions
- **Sunday (March 21):** SXSW concludes with final day of festival programming


The complete session catalog and 2027 SXSW app will continue to take shape as the event approaches. Once available, use the online schedule and app to save events, review venue locations, and build your agenda.\[4\]


### Reserve your highest-priority events


SXSW reservations allow badgeholders to reserve space at select sessions, screenings, showcases, and other events. Reservations account for only part of each venue's capacity, and walk-up lines will remain available.\[4\]


Reservation access opens at the following times:


- **11 a.m. CT on Tuesday, March 9:** Platinum and CxO badgeholders can begin making reservations.
- **2 p.m. CT on Tuesday, March 9:** Reservation access opens for all badgeholders.
- **11 a.m. CT on Sunday, March 14:** Platinum, CxO, and Film & TV badgeholders gain access to unlimited, nonconflicting screening reservations.


Platinum and CxO badges include three reservations per day. Innovation, Film & TV, and Music badges include two reservations per day.\[4\] Prioritize events where capacity is likely to be limited, but keep backup options in case your first choices are unavailable.


### Build a plan around your priorities


Review the schedule before the event and organize your agenda around the sessions, industries, and people most relevant to your work. Group events by location whenever possible, then leave room for unexpected conversations and the time required to move between venues.


Here are a few ways to prepare before you arrive:


- **Sessions:** Save your must-attend sessions, screenings, and showcases in the SXSW app or online schedule, but avoid filling every available time slot.
- **Meetings:** Contact partners, customers, colleagues, or other attendees about two weeks before SXSW to schedule meetings or coffee chats.
- **Logistics:** Connect your badge to your SXSW ID, download the app when the 2027 version becomes available, and save the locations of your primary venues and clubhouse.\[2\]\[4\]
- **Contacts:** Decide whether you'll exchange information through LinkedIn, digital business cards, or another method, and add a brief note after each conversation to preserve context.


Once you know which days and venues your agenda will cover, use our[business trip planning guide](https://navan.com/blog/edge/how-to-plan-a-business-trip) to coordinate your flights, hotel, and departure plans around your schedule.


## What to pack and wear at SXSW


Business casual or tech casual attire works for most SXSW programming, such as jeans or chinos, collared shirts, knit layers, and comfortable sneakers. If you're meeting with customers, investors, executives, or potential partners, consider packing a blazer or another polished option for dinners and evening events.


March in Austin typically brings daytime highs around 73°F and overnight lows near 49°F, with roughly 2.9 inches of precipitation during the month.\[15\] Because you'll move between outdoor routes and air-conditioned venues, pack layers that are easy to add or remove.


### Conference essentials


A few practical items can make long days of sessions, meetings, screenings, and showcases more comfortable. Add these essentials to your packing list:


- **Two pairs of comfortable shoes:** Rotating supportive shoes can help when you're walking between downtown venues and standing in lines.
- **Portable charger and charging cable:** The SXSW app, maps, messaging, note-taking, and photos can quickly drain your phone's battery.
- **Reusable water bottle:** It's easy to forget to drink water while moving between sessions, meetings, and evening events.
- **Light rain jacket:** A packable waterproof layer can keep you dry during outdoor walks without taking up much room in your bag.
- **Sweater or light jacket:** Conference rooms and theaters may feel considerably cooler than the temperature outside.
- **Small backpack or crossbody bag:** Choose something comfortable enough to carry your charger, water bottle, extra layer, and meeting materials throughout the day.
- **Sunscreen and sunglasses:** Even mild March days can involve extended periods outdoors while walking or waiting in line.
- **Earplugs:** Hearing protection is useful for music showcases, comedy venues, parties, and other loud events.
- **Throat lozenges and hand sanitizer:** Crowded venues, late nights, and hours of conversation can take a toll.
- **Blister supplies and basic medications:** Pack bandages, pain relievers, and any other essentials you won't want to search for during a full day of programming.


## Getting from the airport to SXSW venues


Austin-Bergstrom International Airport (AUS) is around 8 miles southeast of downtown Austin and provides convenient access to the hotels and venues hosting SXSW programming.\[8\]\[12\]


For most attendees traveling with luggage, a rideshare or taxi is the simplest option. Arriving passengers can reach the rideshare and taxi pickup area by taking the tram from the first floor of the Red Garage to the Consolidated Rental Car Facility. CapMetro Route 20 offers a lower-cost alternative for travelers staying downtown and boards on the lower level outside baggage claim.\[11\]\[12\]

Once you're downtown, walking will often be the easiest way to move between nearby venues. Rideshares, taxis, and public transit can help with longer trips, but traffic and street closures may increase travel times during SXSW. Complimentary SXSW shuttles will connect badgeholders with most official Film & TV screening venues, but they aren't intended as general transportation throughout the downtown event footprint.\[2\]


## Beyond sessions: Make time for the Creative Village and clubhouses


Some of the most useful parts of SXSW happen outside scheduled sessions. Leave time for the Creative Village, industry clubhouses, brand activations, informal meetings, and conversations between events rather than filling every hour with reservations.


- **Schedule meetings before you arrive:** Contact partners, customers, exhibitors, speakers, and other attendees about two weeks before SXSW to arrange short meetings or coffee chats.
- **Identify priority contacts:** Review the announced speakers, exhibitors, SXSW Pitch participants, filmmakers, and artists, then focus your outreach on the people and organizations most relevant to your work.
- **Use your clubhouse as a home base:** Innovation attendees can spend time at Brazos Hall, Film & TV attendees at 800 Congress, and Music attendees at Thompson Austin. Clubhouses provide space for industry programming, meetings, and informal conversations.\[2\]
- **Group activities by location:** Schedule sessions, meetings, and events in the same part of downtown whenever possible to reduce unnecessary travel.
- **Leave unscheduled time:** Keep gaps in your agenda for brand activations, unexpected introductions, and conversations that continue beyond their scheduled time.
- **Use the SXSW app:** Once available, use the app to save events, monitor schedule or venue changes, and review reservation information.\[4\]
- **Take notes after each conversation:** Record the person's name, relevant details, and agreed-upon next step while the discussion is still fresh.
- **Follow up within 48 hours:** Send a brief email or LinkedIn message that references your conversation and proposes a clear next step.
- **Build in short breaks:** Leave time to eat, drink water, recharge your phone, and return to your hotel if your schedule allows.


Start networking before SXSW and continue after you leave. A focused group of relevant conversations with clear next steps will generally be more useful than collecting contacts you won't remember after the event.


## What to eat at SXSW 2027


Long days of sessions, meetings, screenings, and events can make it easy to skip meals or rely on activation snacks. Start the day with a filling breakfast, keep a protein bar or another easy snack in your bag, and drink water throughout the day so you're not running on coffee alone by midafternoon.


When it's time for a client dinner, team meal, or quick lunch, consider these options:


- **Client dinner:** Jeffrey's at 1204 West Lynn Street offers steaks, seafood, an extensive wine list, and private dining in the Napoleon Room and The Apartment. The Clarksville restaurant is a short rideshare from downtown, and advance reservations are recommended.\[13\]
- **Team meal:** Easy Tiger's South Lamar beer garden and bakery at 3508 South Lamar Boulevard serves pretzels, sandwiches, smoked meats, beer, and other casual fare. Its outdoor space can accommodate a more relaxed team gathering, but you'll need a rideshare from downtown.\[14\]
- **Quick lunch:** Downtown hotels, food halls, coffee shops, and fast-casual restaurants provide convenient options between sessions. Look for something near your next venue rather than crossing downtown solely for lunch.


If you're planning a client dinner or team meal, reserve it before you arrive. Navan Edge can book Austin restaurants in the same chat where you arrange your flight and hotel.


## Finish strong on departure day


Before you check out, take a few minutes to organize your receipts, notes, and new contacts so you're not sorting through the week after you return home. Travelers departing Sunday, March 21, should also allow extra time at AUS as attendees begin leaving Austin.


- **Pack the night before:** Charge your devices, lay out your travel clothes, and check the room for chargers, badges, and anything else you may have left behind.
- **Confirm late checkout:** If you have an evening flight, ask the front desk about late checkout or have Navan Edge coordinate the request on your behalf.
- **Arrive early at the airport:** Allow at least two hours for a domestic flight and three hours for an international departure. Traffic and airport lines may be heavier as SXSW concludes.
- **Submit expenses early:** Upload receipts while the trip's meals, transportation, and hotel charges are still easy to remember, and note any lodging above your company's allowance when you file.
- **Visit the airport lounge:** If you have lounge access, use the time to organize notes, respond to messages, or begin following up before boarding.
- **Schedule a debrief:** Block time early the following week to share relevant findings, reconnect with new contacts, and identify next steps for your team.


## Make the most of your SXSW 2027 trip


SXSW 2027 brings business leaders, founders, investors, marketers, technologists, filmmakers, musicians, creators, and other professionals together across downtown Austin. Choose a hotel near your primary programming, build a realistic travel budget, reserve your highest-priority events, and leave room for clubhouse conversations and unexpected discoveries. Because SXSW combines so many industries and event formats, the most worthwhile trip won't look the same for every attendee. Focus on the sessions, meetings, screenings, showcases, and connections that support your goals.
